description: Fetch the exact contents of ONE public web URL live from its origin server and return them verbatim with a SHA-256 hash of the bytes received. Use it to read a specific page, raw data file (CSV, TSV, .dat, JSON, XML), API endpoint or PDF whose address you already know. format "auto" (default) returns readable text for HTML and PDF and the raw body for everything else; "raw" returns the body itself (decoded text, or base64 for binary such as zip/xlsx); "text" forces text extraction. A PDF also returns page_count and pages[] ({page, text}, 1-based) so a passage can be cited by page; a page with no extractable text (a scan) is listed with text "" and ocr:false (no OCR is done), and when max_bytes cuts the list pages_truncated is true and next_page names where to resume with page. Large bodies page with max_bytes and offset. Also returns url_final, the redirect chain, status, response headers, charset and how it was chosen. Refusals are explicit: blocked_url (private address, disallowed port or scheme, credentials in the URL), upstream_refused (the site answered 401/403/429 or a bot wall; the response names archive_evidence as a place to look for a capture), upstream_down, upstream_status (e.g. 404). Static fetch by default. When a page is built by script (a client-routed app shell, or almost no text and many scripts) the tool re-reads it in a headless browser and returns the rendered text with rendered_fully:true and rendered_via:"headless"; if no render is possible it says rendered_fully:false with a rendering_note instead of presenting the shell as the page. Budgets protect the origin: 1,000 fetches a day per site across all callers, and no single caller may use more than 25% of that (250 a day per site; a named service key can be granted a larger share). A refusal budget_exhausted names the limit it hit in budget_scope (caller_share, host_total or internal_sub_budget) and gives retry_after_s. Does not log in, send cookies or search; for a past version of a page use archive_evidence. Keyless.

format.description: auto (default): text for HTML and PDF, raw for everything else. raw: the body as received. text: readable text extracted from HTML/PDF.

max_bytes.description: Size of the returned window. Default 100000. Maximum 1000000 for text, 512000 for base64 (binary).

offset.description: Where the window starts: a byte offset into the body (raw), or a character offset into the extracted text (text). Use next_offset from the previous call to page. Default 0.

page.description: PDF only: the 1-based page where the page-numbered pages[] list starts. Use next_page from the previous call when pages_truncated is true. Default 1. Does not change text or offset.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL to fetch, e.g. "https://data.giss.nasa.gov/gistemp/tabledata_v4/GLB.Ts+dSST.csv". http:// is tried over https first.

name: fetch_url

cache_age_s.description: Null in every sampled response; type not observed, so left unconstrained.

content-language.description: Null in every sampled response; type not observed, so left unconstrained.
